title: EvidenceRecord
immutability: No update, no delete operation exists on this record type, permanently. The database bootstrap installs delete-revoking triggers on evidence_records.

file_hash.description: SHA-256. Integrity proof AND document-level dedup key.

derived_record_ids.description: JSON array — the container's children. Appended only via link_children; never removed.

interface_note: Contract 1.4 (dispatch.evidence module): register(file_path, document_type, metadata) archives BEFORE any extraction, computes SHA-256, sets the file read-only, inserts the EvidenceRecord, writes the Library index entry, returns the record. Duplicate hash -> returns existing record flagged duplicate_document. retrieve(evidence_record_id) verifies hash on read; mismatch raises and queues an exception queue item. link_children(evidence_record_id, derived_record_ids) appends to the child list. No update, no delete, permanently.
